business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Consignment and Secondhand Luxury Goods Retail

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Mainland China (WFOE registration target), with Hong Kong SAR as the upstream foreign investor jurisdiction
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Civil Law for mainland China WFOE; Common Law for Hong Kong SAR investor)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Agreement on Investment under the Mainland and Hong Kong Closer Economic Partnership Arrangement (CEPA Investment Agreement)
Arrangement between the Mainland of China and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: PRC Anti-Money Laundering Law (2024 revised); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information of Market Entities (People's Bank of China and State Administration for Market Regulation Order No. 3, effective 1 November 2024); Measures for Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Supervision and Administration of Financial Institutions; SAMR Provisions on Enterprise Name Registration and Administration.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Hong Kong parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Hong Kong Companies Registry (Registrar of Companies)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: certified extract from the Hong Kong Companies Registry, then Apostille certificate issued by the High Court of the Hong Kong SAR Authentication of Documents Registry; no PRC consular legalization. If the parent were incorporated in a non-Hague state, the mutually exclusive and alternative path would be consular legalization by the Chinese Embassy or Consulate in that state; apostille and consular legalization must never be chained.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (current standing certificate) of the Hong Kong parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: official certificate from the Hong Kong Companies Registry, then Apostille by the High Court of the Hong Kong SAR Authentication of Documents Registry; no PRC consular legalization. For a non-Hague state origin, use sole consular legalization by the PRC diplomatic mission and do not stack with apostille.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution of the Hong Kong parent authorizing WFOE incorporation and appointing the local formation agent with Power of Attorney
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the Hong Kong parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized certified copy by a Hong Kong notary public, then Apostille issued by the High Court of the Hong Kong SAR; no PRC consular legalization because Hong Kong and mainland China are both Hague Apostille Convention parties. The non-Hague alternative is notarization plus Chinese consular legalization alone; never both.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Hong Kong parent company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Hong Kong parent company (certified copy from Hong Kong Companies Registry)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille path: certified copy from the Hong Kong Companies Registry, then Apostille by the High Court of the Hong Kong SAR; no PRC consular legalization. If the company is organized in a non-Hague jurisdiction, use Chinese consular legalization of the certified copy as the sole path.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter for the Hong Kong parent company's operative account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Hong Kong bank maintaining the parent company's operating account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original bank letter on bank letterhead with a banker's signature; signature authenticated by a Hong Kong notary public and then covered by an Apostille from the High Court of the Hong Kong SAR; no PRC consular legalization. For a bank in a non-Hague state, the only permitted path is consular legalization of the banker's signature at the Chinese Embassy or Consulate.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Before any filing, the compliance provider must screen all intended UBOs, directors, shareholders, and authorized signatories against the UN Consolidated List, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, HKSAR gazetted terrorist lists, PRC-relevant sanctions lists, and the World Bank/ADB debarment databases, using full-name, phonetic, alias, and date-of-birth matching algorithms. Enhanced continuous monitoring applies because PEP status includes immediate family members and close associates; any PEP or sanctions hit triggers risk-based enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds verification, senior management approval, and regulatory notifications as applicable. Formation may not proceed until negative screening is independently re-confirmed.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Enterprise Name Registration System (NENRS) of the State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR), accessed through the local Market Regulation Administration's integrated online government platform
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: For WFOE formation, the enterprise name must be composed in simplified Chinese characters; the statutory sequence is administrative division + distinctive trade name (including a Chinese transliteration of the foreign investor) + industry or business characteristic + organizational form. Roman letters, Arabic numerals, and punctuation are not permitted in the registered name; only standard simplified Chinese characters are accepted, and a Chinese phonetic transliteration of the Hong Kong parent's name must be filed. The name must not be misleading, must not imitate well-known trademarks, and must contain at least one Chinese character in the distinctive segment.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant must first review the SAMR refusal reasons in the Online Name Application system. Within 15 calendar days of refusal, the foreign investor or its appointed local agent shall submit a written administrative reconsideration request to the superior SAMR or the municipal government, annexing the proposed Chinese name, the Hong Kong parent's certified translation, trademark search results, and the original rejection notice. The appeal must explain why the name is distinctive and not misleading; if the rejection relates to a prohibited or sensitive token, the applicant must obtain the competent ministry's prior written clearance before re-filing. A supplementary re-submission can be made on the same portal without additional fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office or commercial mailbox will be rejected by SAMR, tax, and banks for a WFOE engaged in medium-risk luxury resale. SAMR requires a fixed, commodity-use (non-residential) address evidenced by the lease agreement and a copy of the landlord's title certificate; banks performing AML enhanced due diligence demand proof of physical operations, and the tax authority will refuse to issue a tax registration certificate if the address is merely a virtual mailbox. A serviced office or co-working space may be acceptable only if it is a genuine address with on-site staff, a nameplate, rental invoices, and a registered lease of at least 12 months; however, the WFOE must also maintain independent business records, bank statements, and employment records at that location.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: 65% probability of an unannounced physical inspection by the municipal Market Regulation Administration and State Taxation Administration within the first 12 months, increasing to 80% if the declared address is a co-working space. Checklist: posted enterprise nameplate; lease and utility receipts; availability of the legal representative or manager; original company seal and passports; books and records; employment contracts and social insurance attendance; bank correspondence; sufficient inventory evidence for cross-border e-commerce.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory official fee abolished; no government filing fee currently charged

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official HKSAR High Court fee per Apostille plus notary fees at the HKSAR Law Society scale

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: PRC-certified translation firm registered with the local justice bureau
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per simplified Chinese character block; RMB 300-800 per document

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Physical serviced office subscription for registered address and commercial substance (first quarter)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed serviced office provider in the selected Shanghai or Shenzhen district
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing commercial market rent; no statutory tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Public Security Bureau-licensed seal engraving vendor

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Independent AML/PEP/sanctions screening and compliance file setup
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: External AML data provider and retained counsel

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate bank account onboarding support and bank enhanced due diligence coordination
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Retained PRC law firm; excludes bank charges
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing legal market benchmark for account-opening assistance package

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 4, 8, 23, 24, 31, 32, 33, 41, 47, 59, 60, 68, 83 and 89; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China, Articles 2, 6, 12, 13, 17, 28 and 29; Regulations on Registration Administration of Market Entities; Provisions on the Administration of Information Reporting for Foreign Investment
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the local Market Supervision Administration of the district or municipality where the WFOE registered office is situated; online filing is made via the National Enterprise Registration Online Service of SAMR
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Establishment Registration Application (market entity establishment registration form) together with the Foreign Investment Information Report Form
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to an ordinary WFOE under the 2023 Company Law. The registered capital is fixed in the Articles of Association and must be fully subscribed by the sole foreign shareholder. Under Article 47 of the Company Law, all subscribed capital must be paid in full within five years from establishment, unless a shorter period is required by the Articles of Association or applicable sector-specific rules. There is no blocked escrow account requirement. The shareholder contributes capital in RMB or lawful foreign currency through the company's foreign exchange capital account at a designated bank, and the bank reports the foreign direct investment capital flow under the SAFE system. A capital verification report is not mandatory for ordinary ISIC 4791 retail activities, but it may be obtained for corporate governance comfort.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA RESOLUTIONS OF THE FIRST MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED (the Company). WHEREAS the Company is to be incorporated as a wholly foreign-owned enterprise under the laws of the People's Republic of China and registered with the State Administration for Market Regulation; and WHEREAS the initial directors and officers have been designated in accordance with the Company Law and the Articles of Association; and WHEREAS the Company will engage in online consignment and second-hand vintage luxury goods retail under ISIC 4791, with payment facilitation through Stripe and EscrowPay; and WHEREAS it is necessary and proper to adopt resolutions on share capital subscription, banking arrangements, registered office adoption, and statutory officer appointments. NOW THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED AS FOLLOWS. 1. SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION: RESOLVED, that the registered capital of the Company be fixed at [amount] divided into [number] ordinary shares of [par value] each, such shares being fully subscribed by the sole shareholder [shareholder name]; and that the contribution schedule set out in the Articles of Association be approved, with full payment to be completed no later than five years from incorporation. 2. BANKING AUTHORIZATION: RESOLVED, that [bank name] be appointed as the principal bank of the Company; that the Legal Representative or, jointly, the General Manager and Chief Financial Officer, be authorized to open bank accounts, execute bank mandate forms, sign electronic banking agreements, and establish payment gateway arrangements with Stripe and EscrowPay; and that all related agreements be adopted and ratified. 3. REGISTERED OFFICE ADOPTION: RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company be established at [address]; and that the Legal Representative be authorized to execute the lease agreement, landlord consent, floor plan certification, and all documents required by the local Market Supervision Administration for the registered office. 4. STATUTORY OFFICER APPOINTMENTS: RESOLVED, that [name] be appointed Legal Representative and Executive Director; that [name] be appointed Supervisor; that [name] be appointed General Manager; and that the General Manager also serve as the anti-money laundering compliance officer responsible for the Company's seller due diligence, luxury goods authenticity verification, consumer protection filings, and regulatory correspondence. 5. GOVERNANCE AND OPERATIONAL FILINGS: RESOLVED, that the Legal Representative, Executive Director and General Manager be authorized, jointly and severally, to make all tax registrations, social insurance registrations, statistics filings, seal procurements, electronic invoicing applications, website ICP filings and any ancillary licensing applications; and that any prior actions taken between the date of the business license and the date of these resolutions be hereby confirmed, adopted and ratified in full. These resolutions shall be effective immediately and shall remain in force until amended or revoked by a subsequent board resolution or by the sole shareholder in accordance with law.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-registration name verification, business scope negative-list screening, and foreign investor authentication
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Registration Online Service; in Free Trade Zones, the local Market Supervision Administration one-stop enterprise registration service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The foreign shareholder or authorized formation counsel must register on the SAMR online enterprise registration portal and submit three proposed company names in simplified Chinese characters together with the proposed business scope aligned with ISIC 4791, namely online retail and consignment of second-hand luxury goods. The system automatically checks for name duplication and screens the business scope against the Foreign Investment Negative List. For ISIC 4791 retail activity, no equity restriction or advance approval is anticipated. The applicant must also verify the consistency between the proposed English company name and the Chinese registered name, and must ensure that the ultimate beneficial owner information is available for anti-money laundering screening. The chosen name must be reserved before the formal incorporation application is made.
required_dossiers: Name pre-approval application form completed in the SAMR portal
Passport copy or corporate certificate of the foreign shareholder
Power of attorney authorizing the local formation agent or counsel
Proposed business scope and registered capital details
Foreign Investment Negative List self-assessment statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or suspended because of duplication, submit an alternate proposed name in the same online session within three business days. If the negative-list screening query is raised, file a supplementary explanation letter together with the adjusted business scope wording and supporting constitutional documents; SAMR will reconsider within an additional three business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and legalization of the Hong Kong shareholder corporate records and preparation of constitutional documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: China-Appointed Notary Public in Hong Kong SAR, the PRC notarial document transmission mechanism, and the formation counsel responsible for final submission preparation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before the SAMR filing is made, the Hong Kong corporate shareholder must have its Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, latest Annual Return, directors register, shareholders register, incumbency certificate, and the corporate board resolution authorizing the formation of the WFOE notarized by a China-Appointed Notary Public in Hong Kong. The notarial transcript is then transmitted to the relevant PRC notary association or document exchange office. Formation counsel must confirm that the authorised signatories, beneficial owners and corporate powers of the Hong Kong shareholder are fully disclosed and that the execution authority is unambiguous. The Articles of Association, appointment forms for the executive director, legal representative, supervisor and general manager, and the first board resolution must be prepared in a bilingual format, signed by all required parties and timed to comply with the SAMR submission window.
required_dossiers: Hong Kong Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing issued within the previous six months
Hong Kong Annual Return and incumbency certificate
Directors register and shareholders register of the Hong Kong shareholder
Notarized board resolution of the Hong Kong shareholder authorizing the incorporation of the WFOE
Proposed Articles of Association of the WFOE signed by the sole shareholder
Power of attorney appointing local formation counsel or registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary queries the incumbency or beneficial ownership documentation, obtain updated registers from the Hong Kong Companies Registry and resubmit to the same notary within five business days. If the PRC transmission office rejects the notarial transcript, contact the designated transmission officer and cure the missing seal, signature, or attestation page within five business days; thereafter the notarial package may be re-transmitted without repeating the entire corporate review process.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the establishment registration to SAMR and issuance of the business license
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Market Supervision Administration at the district or municipal administrative service center for market entity registration, or the SAMR online one-stop establishment window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The formation agent must submit the complete establishment registration application through the SAMR online platform or at the designated service hall. The submission must include the notarized Hong Kong shareholder documents, the signed Articles of Association, the lease agreement and property ownership certificate for the registered office, the landlord consent letter, the appointment forms for the legal representative, executive director, supervisor and general manager, identification documents of the appointees, and the Foreign Investment Information Report. SAMR will verify the legality of the corporate governance structure, the accuracy of registered capital, the business scope, and the compliance of registered address. Upon approval, SAMR will issue the business license bearing the unified social credit code, and the company becomes a legal person. The license must be collected by the legal representative or by an authorized agent carrying the original power of attorney and valid identification.
required_dossiers: Company Establishment Registration Application in the standard SAMR format
Foreign Investment Information Report
Notarized corporate documents of the Hong Kong shareholder
Articles of Association signed by the sole shareholder and countersigned by the legal representative
Registered office lease agreement and property ownership certificate or landlord consent
Identity or passport copies of the legal representative, executive director, supervisor and general manager
Name reservation notice issued in step one
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SAMR suspends or returns the application, the applicant must read the written rectification notice, correct all formal defects such as signature pages, notarial certification, address documents or duplicate business scope items, and resubmit within ten working days. If the registered office is queried, obtain and submit a revised landlord consent and a certified floor plan within the same period. If the negative-list screening leads to an administrative refusal, the applicant may file a fresh application with a restructured shareholding or request administrative review before the same authority.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-incorporation governance: adoption of the first board resolution, bank account opening, and foreign exchange capital account filing with SAFE
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: The Company's appointed commercial bank licensed by the State Council financial regulator, acting as a direct reporting bank under the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after obtaining the business license, the legal representative must convene the first board meeting and adopt the pro-forma board resolutions approving the share capital subscription, banking authorization, registered office adoption and statutory officer appointments. Thereafter the legal representative, general manager and chief financial officer must open a basic deposit account and a foreign exchange capital account at a bank that can receive the overseas remittance from the Hong Kong shareholder. The bank will complete the foreign direct investment foreign exchange registration with SAFE online and provide a capital account notification. The Hong Kong shareholder must remit the subscribed capital into the capital account in accordance with the approved contribution schedule. The bank will carry out anti-money-laundering screening and source-of-funds verification, and the company must maintain the board minutes, share register, and statutory corporate book records.
required_dossiers: Business license with unified social credit code
First board resolution in original form bearing signatures of the directors
Articles of Association as registered
Legal representative identification and appointment certificate
Supervisor appointment form and consent to act
General manager and chief financial officer appointment forms
Bank account opening forms and company seal specimen card
FDI foreign exchange registration questionnaire completed by the bank
Hong Kong shareholder remittance instruction and bank reference letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank or SAFE rejects the FDI registration because of a mismatch between the registered capital and the remittance amount, the company must issue a revised contribution schedule or amend the Articles of Association by shareholder resolution and file the alteration with SAMR. If the bank mandate card or electronic banking token is rejected, correct the signatory documentation and re-execute the bank forms under a confirmatory board resolution within five business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory post-filing registrations: tax, social insurance, statistics, company seals, invoicing and e-commerce ICP filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local office of the State Taxation Administration (STA); local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau; local Public Security Bureau-approved seal engraving service; and the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT) through the licensed hosting provider for ICP filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the business license is issued and bank accounts are operative, the company must complete taxpayer registration in the electronic tax bureau, activate electronic invoicing, and elect VAT registration status, including whether to apply as a general VAT taxpayer. The company must register social insurance, housing fund contributions, payroll withholding and statistics reporting. The legal representative must obtain the company seal, finance seal, legal representative seal and contract seal from a public-security approved engraving shop and retain the seal registration record. If the company operates its own e-commerce website, an ICP filing must be submitted through the licensed hosting provider and approved before the website will be publicly accessible. For sales through third-party platforms using Stripe and EscrowPay, no separate payment institution license is required in the WFOE itself, but the company must implement an internal anti-money-laundering manual covering seller due diligence, product authentication, transaction monitoring and consumer protection.
required_dossiers: Business license and unified social credit code certificate
Legal representative and finance officer identification documents
Bank account opening certificate in the company name
Registered office lease agreement and utilities bill
Company seal imprints and seal registration receipt
Social insurance and housing fund registration forms
Tax registration confirmation form and VAT general taxpayer application
Electronic invoicing activation application
ICP filing form, domain name certificate and hosting service agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is not automatically synchronized from SAMR, visit the local STA service hall with the business license and unified social credit code and resolve the discrepancy within five business days. If the ICP filing is rejected, the hosting provider must correct the domain ownership, server region or filing category and resubmit. Additional social insurance or housing fund deficiencies may be cured by completing the employee roster and paying the applicable arrears plus statutory late payment surcharge before the authority closes the case.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable - no manufacturing, chemical, assembly, or primary warehousing operations are established under ISIC 4791. If the company later introduces ancillary physical production, repair, polishing, chemical treatment or dedicated fulfillment warehousing, the competent authorities would be the local Market Supervision Administration for production and business licensing, the local Emergency Management Bureau for work safety, the local Ecology and Environment Bureau for environmental review, and the local Fire and Rescue Department for fire-safety approval.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - ISIC 4791 online retail and consignment of second-hand luxury goods does not require a statutory industrial operating license under the PRC Foreign Investment Negative List. The only operational prerequisites at formation are the general business license issued by SAMR and, if the company operates its own website, an ICP filing with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology through a licensed hosting provider. Payment facilitation through Stripe and EscrowPay does not require a payment institution license in the WFOE itself.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not Applicable at formation; if later manufacturing, polishing, cleaning or large-scale warehousing is added, the Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China and the municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau will have jurisdiction.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt for ISIC 4791 online retail under the PRC Environmental Impact Assessment Catalogue; no full EIA report or environmental registration is required solely for e-commerce retail of second-hand luxury goods. An environmental registration filing would become mandatory only if the company adds activities that fall within a listed EIA category, such as surface treatment, coating, hazardous waste storage or bulk warehousing.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable at formation; no regulated point source wastewater, VOC or hazardous waste streams arise from ISIC 4791 online retail. If ancillary physical handling is introduced, the company must comply with the Integrated Wastewater Discharge Standard (GB 8978-1996) Level 3 thresholds, including COD not exceeding 500 mg/L, BOD5 not exceeding 300 mg/L and SS not exceeding 400 mg/L, together with the applicable local atmospheric VOC emission standards and the hazardous waste transfer manifest system under the Law on the Prevention and Control of Environmental Pollution by Solid Waste.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable at formation - no physical manufacturing or primary warehousing is licensed under ISIC 4791. If the company later operates a fulfillment center, sorting facility or restoration workshop, the local Fire and Rescue Department must issue a fire safety acceptance certificate and approve the fire protection plan under the Fire Protection Law of the PRC; the local Emergency Management Bureau must register the workplace under the Work Safety Law of the PRC; and an occupational hazard evaluation and corresponding protective measures must be implemented before the workplace is put into operation.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA) via the Electronic Tax Bureau online portal (e-Tax), administered through the provincial and municipal STA branches for the place of registration of the WFOE
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: Register the Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (WFOE) as a PRC domestic company with the local State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) using the National Enterprise Registration Online Service to obtain the Business License and Unified Social Credit Code (USCC). Step 2: The USCC automatically constitutes the WFOE's statutory Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) for all PRC national tax purposes, including enterprise income tax, VAT and customs duties; no separately issued TIN certificate is created for a newly formed WFOE. Step 3: Complete the initial tax registration in the Electronic Tax Bureau portal within 30 days after the Business License is issued, including filing of the legal representative, registered address, bank settlement account details, accounting policy and statutory books and records. Step 4: Classify the VAT taxpayer status as either small-scale taxpayer or general VAT taxpayer in accordance with the annual taxable sales threshold, and register the applicable VAT categories. Step 5: If the WFOE will export vintage luxury goods, complete the export tax refund/exemption filing with the competent STA office and register with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) for goods trade foreign exchange monitoring. Step 6: Non-resident shareholders are not issued PRC TINs; their ownership is documented through the foreign investment information reporting system and, if applicable, the non-resident enterprise withholding tax registration is maintained separately.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law does not provide US-style check-the-box elections, partnership tax classification elections, or hybrid mismatch elections. A WFOE incorporated under PRC law is automatically a PRC resident enterprise with entity-level taxation on its worldwide income; no elective regime exists to alter this treatment.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: All PRC-incorporated WFOEs must complete VAT registration upon incorporation; no economic turnover threshold applies to the initial registration of a corporate entity. Mandatory general VAT taxpayer status is triggered when annual taxable sales exceed RMB 5,000,000; below that threshold the WFOE may remain a small-scale taxpayer and apply the simplified VAT method. Small-scale taxpayers with monthly taxable sales not exceeding RMB 100,000 (or quarterly sales not exceeding RMB 300,000) are exempt from VAT under current national rules. For the resale of secondhand and vintage luxury goods, if the goods qualify as used goods, a simplified VAT collection method at the statutory reduced rate of 3% reduced to 2% may apply instead of the standard 13% goods rate.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The STA has implemented the All-round Digitalized Electronic Invoice (ADEI) regime and the Golden Tax Phase IV anti-fraud control system. VAT invoices, including Special Value-Added Tax Invoices and ordinary invoices, must be issued through the STA's official electronic invoice service platform using Tax U-Key or enterprise digital credentials. Each invoice is transmitted in real time to the STA central database, automatically assigned a unique invoice code and digital sequence number, and made available for immediate taxpayer verification through the National VAT Invoice Verification System. No physical fiscal stamp is required, but corrections must be executed through the prescribed normal invoice and red invoice workflow. Cross-border e-commerce retail export transactions must additionally submit order, payment and logistics data to the China International Trade Single Window to enable customs clearance, export monitoring and VAT treatment consistency.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A PRC VAT-registered WFOE is eligible to apply the VAT zero rate to exported vintage luxury goods where the goods are physically dispatched from the PRC customs territory, including shipments to Hong Kong SAR as a separate customs territory, to an overseas destination; the WFOE is the named exporter on a valid customs export declaration; the sale is supported by a genuine cross-border sales contract and invoicing; the overseas customer pays the consideration in foreign currency or through an approved cross-border payment method; and the export proceeds are received and repatriated into China through a licensed banking channel. Claiming the zero rate requires the WFOE to file an export tax refund/exemption declaration with the STA. Cross-border e-commerce retail exports using customs supervision mode codes 9610, 9710 or 9810 may qualify for VAT exemption/refund when the transaction is integrated through the China International Trade Single Window. Any qualifying offshore digital services would be zero-rated only if consumed entirely outside China and specifically recognized in the STA zero-rating category list; for this physical goods business, actual export and foreign exchange repatriation are the controlling criteria.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Goods Declaration (Customs Export Declaration Form) bearing the WFOE's customs registration code
Original Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or international logistics receipt evidencing departure from China and delivery outside China
Commercial invoice and detailed packing list for the overseas buyer
Export sales contract or consignment agreement evidencing the cross-border transaction
Bank export foreign exchange collection certificate or bank credit receipt evidencing receipt and repatriation of export proceeds through a licensed Chinese settlement bank
China International Trade Single Window cross-border e-commerce order, payment and logistics matching data for e-commerce retail export modes
Declared export price list and customs valuation supporting documents
VAT invoices or export invoices issued through the ADEI platform for the zero-rated export transaction
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is subject to documentary and data matching review by the STA, PRC Customs and SAFE. If export proceeds are not received or repatriated within the required period and a valid deferred collection extension has not been recorded, the VAT zero rate is denied and any VAT refund already granted must be clawed back with statutory late-payment interest. Under the PRC Tax Collection Administration Law, fraudulent export refund claims or fabricated export documentation attract an administrative penalty of 50% to 500% of the tax amount evaded or under-collected. Customs false declaration rules allow monetary penalties, downgrade of customs credit rating, and forfeiture of export privileges. SAFE may impose monetary fines, suspend certain trade foreign exchange operations, and downgrade the enterprise from A class to B or C class under the goods trade foreign exchange classification system. Where the fraudulent scheme meets the criminal threshold, the WFOE's responsible officers may be subject to criminal prosecution for export tax fraud or smuggling-related offenses under the PRC Criminal Law.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), operating under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China applies current-account convertibility with strict capital-account controls. For a mainland WFOE engaged in online consignment and secondhand luxury goods retail, current-account transactions such as trade payments for goods, logistics, commissions and platform fees are normally convertible after the bank verifies the underlying contract, invoice, customs declaration and proof of transaction. Export proceeds are not subject to a mandatory surrender ratio, but all receipts from overseas trade must be repatriated into a domestic foreign exchange account and cannot remain offshore indefinitely. The capital account is materially more constrained: inward direct investment, shareholder loans, equity transfer proceeds and dividend remittances require either prior SAFE registration or acceptance of registration by the delegated bank. Profit remittance to the Hong Kong parent requires audited financial statements, tax clearance certificates for corporate income tax and withholding tax, a valid board resolution declaring the dividend, and evidence that registered capital has been fully paid in and verified. In practice, genuine current-account payments clear within one to three banking days once documentary compliance is complete, but any mismatch between the e-commerce platform settlement amounts and the WFOE book records will be treated as an FX red flag and may suspend disbursement.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE trade-in-goods administration, there is no fixed statutory surrender ratio; enterprises may retain up to 100% of export proceeds in a domestic foreign exchange settlement account or convert them into RMB at a designated bank. However, the proceeds are required to be repatriated into the mainland banking system within 180 days from the date of customs export declaration unless an approved delayed collection filing is made with SAFE. The WFOE must match each receipt to customs electronic data and the business-name registration in the Foreign Exchange Trade-in-Goods Enterprise List; failure to do so will cause the receipt to be classified as a non-trade capital item and may expose the entity to administrative penalties under the Measures for the Administration of Trade in Goods Foreign Exchange.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign Exchange Capital Account (Capital Escrow Account)
Basic Operational Currency Account and Cross-Border Trade Settlement Account
RMB Basic Deposit Account with Foreign Exchange Settlement Sub-ledger
Corporate Operating Currency Account and Export Proceeds Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Foreign fintech EMIs do not have a lawful role as the principal bank of a mainland WFOE. Under the PRC Commercial Banking Law and the PBOC payment rules, a non-resident entity without a Chinese banking license cannot open the statutory bank accounts used for FDI capital injection, routine corporate tax payments, or employee salary settlement. Some cross-border e-commerce payment institutions such as PingPong, Airwallex and Payoneer can be used in an ancillary collection-only channel via a licensed mainland bank partner, but they cannot replace the SAFE-registered capital account or the domestic bank-compliant clearing anchor. The viable structure is to keep the WFOE statutory treasury at a tier-1 domestic bank and use the EMI only to collect offshore retail receipts that are then settled into the licensed bank through an approved cross-border collection arrangement.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Under the PBOC KYC and customer due diligence requirements, the legal representative or an authorized corporate officer of the WFOE, together with the ultimate beneficial owner where reasonably identifiable, must attend a face-to-face interview at the bank counter during the initial account opening. A remote consular proxy opening is not a generally available right; the bank may accept a physical appearance by a locally resident manager only if the manager holds a notarized power of attorney executed by the legal representative, with the Hong Kong corporate resolutions certified and, where needed, apostilled or consular legalized. The Hong Kong parent corporate kit including incorporation certificate, business registration, register of directors and shareholders, and significant controllers register is mandatory. Video conferencing may supplement but not replace the in-branch identification process.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial ownership opacity through the Hong Kong holding company, especially where individual shareholders are non-resident and not physically present in China.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a certified UBO declaration and corporate chain, including Hong Kong Companies Registry certificates, business registration, register of members and directors, significant controllers register, notarized passports or identity cards of each beneficial owner, board resolutions appointing the WFOE legal representative, and an organizational chart tying each UBO to the capital injection source.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds for the inbound capital injection cannot be verified, or the remittance originates from a third party other than the registered foreign investor.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Supply audited financial statements and bank statements of the direct shareholder for the last two fiscal years, a board resolution authorizing the capital injection, fully executed shareholder loan agreements if debt is used, tax records or dividend certificates explaining accumulated wealth, a SAFE FDI foreign exchange registration form, and a pre-remittance source-of-funds letter addressed to the receiving bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High intrinsic money-laundering and sanctions exposure of the vintage luxury resale business, including counterfeit authentication, provenance gaps, and hidden seller identities.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit a structured luxury-goods compliance program covering third-party authentication certificates, item-level serial numbers and images, supplier and consignor KYC packages with identification and proof of title, audited purchase and consignment contracts, customs declarations, sanctions-screening logs, and a clearly defined escalation protocol for unusual pricing and high-risk brands.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatch between settlement flows collected by Stripe or EscrowPay and the WFOE main bank account, indicating possible unlicensed payment intermediation or undisclosed third-party settlement.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Produce the executed merchant agreements with Stripe and EscrowPay naming the exact WFOE as the contracting merchant, platform identity verification certificates, payout schedules showing remittance into the designated domestic bank account, a transaction-level reconciliation report, platform refund and chargeback logs, and a legal opinion confirming the platform acts solely as an appointed collection agent under PRC law.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The Hong Kong parent must complete SAFE FDI registration in the regional branch or through the delegated bank before wiring. The inbound payment should use SWIFT MT103, with the remitter being the registered foreign shareholder, the beneficiary being the WFOE Foreign Exchange Capital Account, and the remittance information referencing the SAFE ExCode and the purpose 'Inbound Direct Investment Capital Injection'. No third-party payer is acceptable absent a documented and SAFE-approved funding chain. Upon receipt, the bank can process the foreign exchange to RMB settlement for approved capital-account uses under the capital item negative list; a local CPA must then issue a capital verification report to record the paid-in capital, update the National Enterprise Credit Information Exchange, and complete tax and statistical filings. All capital account receipts must be retained in the designated account and cannot be used outside the approved business scope.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For trade settlements, the WFOE may use SWIFT MT103 for supplier and logistics payments, commercial letters of credit for large-value purchase contracts, and documentary collections for low or mid-value consignment purchases. Each outbound remittance must be matched with the goods-trade foreign exchange verification system, using the contract, invoice, customs declaration, transport documents and, for service fees, evidence of actual service delivery. Where the vintage luxury goods are bought through the Hong Kong trading platform, a buy-sell or back-to-back contract must be clearly structured so that payments are correctly classified as import goods rather than service payments. If the WFOE settles cross-border e-commerce purchases through an international card acquirer, it should route the stream through a licensed cross-border payment institution partner bank and ensure all proceeds are settled into the domestic operating account with full transaction data.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable CNY/USD foreign exchange forward contracts with an onshore designated bank, subject to the SAFE real-demand principle and supported by underlying trade receivables or payables documents.

CNY foreign-exchange option contracts, including vanilla call and put and simple barrier structures, purchased from onshore licensed banks with the option premium settled in CNY and no embedded leveraged pay-off.

Cross-currency interest-rate swaps used for restructuring shareholder loans or capital financing where the WFOE can demonstrate an actual medium-term FX exposure and obtains SAFE registration for the hedging transaction.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards are not permissible as an onshore hedging instrument for the WFOE; any NDF must be booked only by the Hong Kong parent and cannot be used to hedge or settle the mainland entity accounts.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Not later than 42 days after each incorporation anniversary date (for private limited companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties range from HK$870 (overdue up to 3 months) to HK$3,000 (overdue more than 12 months); continued default may result in prosecution and administrative strike-off of the company.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Business Registration Office, Inland Revenue Department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after the expiry date of the existing Business Registration Certificate (renewable annually or triennially)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late renewal attracts a maximum penalty of HK$5,000; continued non-renewal may lead to prosecution and the company is liable for additional penalty taxes.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profits Tax Return (BIR51) with Audited Financial Statements and Tax Computation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month from the issue date of the return, unless an extension is granted by the Inland Revenue Department (commonly extended to 15 November for year-end 31 December, or to a date within six months for other year-ends)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty up to HK$10,000 may be imposed; potential additional tax of up to 10% of the amount undercharged; risk of estimated assessment and prosecution for continued non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Employer's Return (BIR56A and IR56B) — applicable if any employees are engaged
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month of the annual BIR56A issuance date, typically in April each year, for the preceding year of assessment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties up to HK$10,000; additional penalties may be assessed for incorrect returns.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All companies incorporated in Hong Kong are mandatorily required to undergo an annual independent audit by a certified public accountant, irrespective of balance sheet size, turnover, or headcount. There are no quantitative exemptions under the Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622); only companies that have validly passed a special resolution to become dormant (inactive) are exempt from audit for that accounting period.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Financial statements must be prepared in accordance with Hong Kong Financial Reporting Standards (HKFRS), HKFRS for Private Entities, or the HKFRS for SMEs as applicable, and audits must be conducted in accordance with Hong Kong Standards on Auditing (HKSAs).

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The company must keep a Significant Controllers Register (SCR) at its registered office and update it within 7 days of any change in significant controllers. Share transfer instruments must be presented for stamping within 30 days of execution. An annual confirmation of members is made through the Annual Return (NAR1), which must contain the latest list of shareholders and changes in ownership.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors and Company Secretaries
Minute Book of General Meetings and Board Meetings

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualifying High-and-New-Technology Enterprises may apply a preferential 15% CIT rate; Hainan Free Trade Port encouraged industries may apply 15%; Shanghai Lingang new key industries may apply 15%; small low-profit enterprises with annual taxable income not exceeding RMB 3 million are effectively taxed at 5% during 2023-2027; R&D expenses enjoy a 100% super-deduction. No general patent box exists, but income from eligible technology licensing or transfer up to RMB 5 million may be exempt. General statutory tax holidays are not automatic for a WFOE engaged in luxury resale and must be separately qualified.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form A100000 (Corporate Income Tax Annual Return, A-Class) together with supporting schedules A101000, A105000 and A105050, filed through the State Taxation Administration electronic tax filing system; quarterly provisional returns are filed on Form A200000 through the same e-taxation portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual comprehensive return plus quarterly provisional prepayments
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly pre-payments must be filed and paid within 15 days after the end of each quarter; the annual reconciliation return and final CIT settlement must be completed within 5 months after the calendar fiscal year-end, i.e. by 31 May.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from online consignment and resale of vintage luxury goods, including sales through e-commerce platforms, direct online storefronts, and cross-border overseas-direct sales.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The WFOE must report income attributable to its own principal risk. If the HK affiliate acts as sales organizer or platform, the WFOE should not repatriate gross resale proceeds through offshore factoring. If the WFOE is a commissionaire or agent for a HK-related principal, it must report commission revenue rather than gross proceeds. Export sales physically shipped from mainland may be VAT zero-rated, but CIT income includes all consideration received through the Chinese payment rails, escrow accounts, and offshore payment processors. Failure to declare off-book WeChat or personal payment streams will support a tax evasion inference.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Inventory acquisition costs, authentication fees, import duties, non-creditable input VAT capitalized into inventory, logistics costs and related-party purchase prices.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Purchases of vintage luxury goods from HK or other related suppliers must be supported by contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation showing arm's-length pricing, preferably under the CUP or Resale Price method. If goods are routed through a HK intermediary solely to inflate purchase cost and strip profit, the tax authority may recharacterize the transaction and disallow the overstated cost. Goods consigned by third-party owners must not be booked as WFOE inventory; only the commission or service fee is recognized as revenue and cost is limited to authentication and logistics expenses.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 - Operating Expenses / Administrative, Selling and General Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Platform commissions, payment-processing fees, authentication, logistics, warehousing, marketing, advertising, staff costs, rent, utilities and intercompany service, royalty or interest charges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Every intercompany service charged by the HK parent must be actually rendered, provide a business benefit, and not be duplicated. Management fees, royalties and interest remitted to HK are payments to a non-resident and trigger withholding tax: 10% statutory, 7% DTA interest, 5% DTA royalties. Deductions will be denied if the payment lacks a written contract, official tax invoice, beneficial ownership support, and a benefit test. Entertainment expenses, fines, penalties, and non-business sponsorship must be added back on Schedule A105000.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 - Non-Taxable and Tax-Exempt Income / Adjustment Add-backs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax-exempt investment income, government subsidies, statutory exemptions, and accounting/tax temporary differences such as excessive entertainment deductions, impairment losses, welfare overruns, and non-deductible intercompany charges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Dividends received from Chinese resident subsidiaries are tax-exempt only if the participation conditions are met and the structure is not an artificial offshore shell arrangement. Expenses lacking an official tax invoice or paid to a zero-substance HK entity must be added back. Interest deductions are limited by the 5:1 debt-equity thin capitalization ratio under CIT Law Article 46; intercompany notes must satisfy arm's-length interest rates and documentation requirements. The Box 4 adjustment must identify any overstated royalty or management fee inbound from HK.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The accounting result of revenue less COGS, operating expenses, non-operating income and non-operating expenses, before tax-law adjustments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The figure must reconcile with audited PRC Accounting Standards financial statements. For cross-border e-commerce structures, no profit should be stripped by intercompany commissions, management fees, buy-in charges, or artificial inventory ownership without a functional analysis. If the tax authority raises a transfer-pricing adjustment, Box 5 will be adjusted to the recharacterized taxable profit, and the deemed additional profit will be taxed at 25% with interest and possible penalties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 - Taxable Income after Losses and Adjustments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after applying loss carryforwards, tax-exempt amounts, special tax adjustments, and intercompany pricing corrections.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Ordinary tax loss carryforward is limited to five years; high-tech and technology-advanced service enterprises may use ten years. Losses generated from offshore platform activities can only offset PRC taxable income if recognized under PRC tax law. Excessive intercompany charges added back in earlier boxes will increase Box 6 taxable income. If a HK parent later receives a dividend, the dividend is calculated from post-CIT after-tax profit and Box 6 is not reduced by the intended dividend amount.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 7 - Tax Rate and Computed Tax Payable
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Application of the 25% statutory CIT rate, preferential 15% rates where qualified, effective 5% small low-profit rate, and quarterly prepayment credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Preferential rates must be documented on the annual return and substantiated by the relevant qualification certificate. A preferential rate applicable to the WFOE does not alter the separate 10% dividend withholding tax on distribution to the non-resident HK shareholder. If the WFOE seeks the reduced 5% China-HK DTA rate, the HK shareholder must hold at least 25% capital throughout the required period and prove beneficial ownership before the dividend is declared; otherwise the withholding rate reverts to 10%.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 - Foreign Tax Credit and Final CIT Payable / Refund
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credit for foreign income tax paid on overseas-source income and calculation of the final amount due or refundable after quarterly prepayments and withholding credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Where the WFOE is directly taxed abroad on vintage luxury export sales, the foreign income tax credit is limited to the PRC CIT payable on the corresponding foreign-source income under Article 23 of the CIT Law. Foreign tax certificates and return computations are required. The final return must be filed by 31 May; underpayment resulting from unreported offshore sales, false beneficial ownership positions, or TP manipulation will attract a 0.05% daily surcharge from the original due date and may trigger criminal fraud referral if the underpayment meets the Criminal Law Article 201 threshold.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file a quarterly or annual return attracts a late-filing penalty of RMB 2,000, up to RMB 10,000 in serious cases, under Tax Administration Law Article 62. Overdue tax payments incur a daily surcharge of 0.05% of the unpaid tax under Article 32. False or fraudulent tax returns are subject to a penalty of 50% to 500% of the underpaid tax under Article 63. Criminal prosecution under Criminal Law Article 201 applies where the evaded tax amount is relatively large (commonly RMB 100,000 or more) and exceeds 10% of total tax payable, resulting in imprisonment up to three years; where the amount is huge and exceeds 30%, imprisonment is three to seven years, together with fines, asset confiscation, blacklisting, and exit-control travel restrictions against the legal representative.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory dividend withholding tax under CIT Law Articles 3 and 37 on dividends distributed to a non-resident enterprise shareholder; reduced to 5% under the China-Hong Kong Double Tax Arrangement only if the HK shareholder is the beneficial owner and has held directly at least 25% of the WFOE's paid-in capital for the relevant holding period; if the 25% threshold or beneficial ownership requirement is not met, the statutory 10% applies.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke the reduced 5% dividend rate, the HK shareholder must (1) obtain a Certificate of Hong Kong Resident Status from the Hong Kong Inland Revenue Department (IR1313A), (2) complete the PRC tax authority's non-resident tax treaty benefit claim form and file it before or at the time of dividend withholding, (3) prove beneficial ownership by demonstrating the HK entity is not a conduit or shell and has substantive operations, premises, employees, and decision-making functions in Hong Kong, (4) provide audited financial statements, shareholding registers, board minutes, and the HK certificate of residence to the withholding agent, and (5) ensure the WFOE remits dividend withholding tax within the statutory period. The tax authority may retrospectively deny the DTA benefit if there is no economic substance or if the principal purpose of the arrangement is to obtain treaty benefits.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory outbound interest and royalty withholding tax is 10% under CIT Law Articles 3, 37 and 38. Under the China-Hong Kong Double Tax Arrangement, outbound interest may be reduced to 7% and outbound royalties to 5%. Reduced treaty rates are conditioned on the HK recipient being the beneficial owner, holding a valid Tax Residency Certificate, and having substantive business substance. Interest paid to financial institutions may benefit from separate provisions; royalties include payments for trademarks, know-how, software, franchise rights, and intellectual property used in the luxury consignment business.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: A contemporaneous Local File is required where annual related-party transactions exceed RMB 200 million for tangible asset purchases/sales, or RMB 100 million for related-party services, intangible asset transfers, or financial asset transfers. A Master File is required when aggregate annual related-party transactions exceed RMB 1 billion. The documentation must be prepared in Chinese and made available to the State Taxation Administration upon request; the annual CIT return must also include Schedule A105050 reporting related-party transactions.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP, Resale Price, Cost Plus, TNMM, Profit Split
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: While mainland China does not maintain a Gulf-style Economic Substance Regulations statute, the PRC Corporate Income Tax Law Articles 41 and 47, together with SAT Public Notice 2018 No. 9, impose substance-over-form and beneficial ownership criteria. The WFOE must demonstrate real Core Income-Generating Activities in the conduct
